## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

ProfileViewModel — app-phone/src/main/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker/ui/profile/ProfileViewModel.kt

## Trigger

A zone threshold field losing focus, in ProfileScreen's ZonesSection —
app-phone/src/main/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker/ui/profile/ProfileScreen.kt

## Today

ProfileViewModel exposes onHrMaxUpdated, onExpectedDistanceChanged and
onLongPressChanged, each calling the matching ProfileRepository
updater. ProfileRepository.updateZoneThreshold(index, value) exists
and is documented (fails outside 30–99 or when the resulting
thresholds are not strictly increasing), but ProfileViewModel never
calls it — no handler method exists for it. ZonesSection in
ProfileScreen only renders each zone row's label, percentLabel and
bpmRangeLabel as static Text; there is no editable field and no
onFocusChanged wiring for the thresholds, unlike the distance and
long-press fields in SettingsFields.

## Expected

ProfileViewModel exposes a handler (mirroring onExpectedDistanceChanged
and onLongPressChanged) that calls
profileRepository.updateZoneThreshold(index, value) for the given zone
index. ProfileScreen's ZonesSection presents each threshold inline as
an editable field, validated on loss of focus like the distance and
long-press fields, and calls that handler.
